rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded blastocyst and visible left-sided ICM, but it overstates certainty about AA-quality TE/ICM from this single image and adds features not clearly discernible, such as uniform circumferential TE and debris interpretation.
Thoroughly integrates age, AMH, BMI, PCOS label, prior losses, sperm parameters, endometrium, and cycle history with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, especially around RPL as the dominant modifier, though some probability adjustments are somewhat subjective and a few claims are stronger than the evidence supports.

Mostly aligned on RPL workup and general IVF counseling, but recommendations such as empiric LMWH without diagnosis, broad inherited thrombophilia screening, NK-cell testing, and ERA use are not strongly guideline-supported.
Provides clear next steps for transfer management, RPL evaluation, and future cycle planning, though some suggested interventions are more controversial than standard practice.
